methods.name: Compositional Perturbation Autoencoder (CPA)
methods.protocol_description: CPA combines interpretability of linear models with flexibility of deep learning. It learns factorized latent representations of perturbations and covariates (cell type, dose, time, species) using an adversarial loss to ensure independence. Perturbation effects are modeled as additive in a nonlinear latent space, with continuous dose encoded via a learned drug-response curve. At prediction time, embeddings are recombined to predict novel perturbation-covariate combinations.

methods.name: chemCPA
methods.protocol_description: Extension of CPA that replaces the perturbation embedding dictionary with a perturbation network encoding small molecules using known chemical descriptors. It comprises a pre-trained molecule encoder G, a perturbation encoder M, and an amortized dosage scaler S. M maps chemical embeddings to latent perturbation effects, while S maps to effective dose given chemical embedding and applied dosage.
